question: As per SRS Bulletin 2020, what was the death rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The death rate in India for the year 2020, as per the **Sample Registration System (SRS) Bulletin**, was reported to be **6 per 1,000 population**.
 
• The **death rate** is defined as the number of deaths occurring per 1,000 individuals in a given year.
 
• The SRS is the **primary source** for accurate and reliable annual estimates of birth rate, death rate, and other fertility and mortality indicators in India.
 
• India’s death rate has been steadily declining over the decades due to improved healthcare facilities, sanitation, and awareness of preventive health measures.
 
• The figures released by the SRS Bulletin are crucial for policy-making and monitoring the progress of health initiatives in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sample Registration System (SRS):**

 
 
• The SRS is a demographic survey conducted by the **Registrar General of India** to provide reliable annual estimates of demographic indicators.
 
• It was initiated in **1970** and is implemented in both rural and urban areas.
 
• The system captures data through continuous enumeration and six-monthly retrospective surveys.
 
 
 
• **Death Rate Trends in India:**
 
 
• India's death rate has significantly declined from **25 per 1,000 population in 1951** to **6 per 1,000 population in 2020**.
 
• This decline is attributed to advancements in medical technology, better healthcare infrastructure, and improved living standards.
 
 
 
• **Mortality Indicators:**
 
 
• Other mortality indicators include **infant mortality rate**, **maternal mortality rate**, and **age-specific mortality rates**.
 
• These indicators help assess the health status and performance of healthcare systems in the country.
 
 
 
• **Health Initiatives in India:**
 
 
• Government programs like **Ayushman Bharat**, **National Health Mission**, and **Janani Suraksha Yojana** aim to reduce mortality rates and improve public health.
 
• These initiatives focus on preventive healthcare, affordability, and accessibility for all citizens.
